EXTENSION: Tier role bindings, decided by the author on 18 November 2026
purpose: 186 ledger tiers had no runtime response, so none of the six World agents could run them. This file binds each of them to one agent role (Monitor, Stabilise, Plan, Repair, Drive, Baseline), so plans and agents can use them.
why_created: ORGANISM (spec/ORGANISM.md) found 186 of 293 tiers unbound; ROLE_ORGANISM proposed roles from the tiers' own words; LEDGER_GRAPH proposed roles from glyph and reference chains and showed that neither method is reliable on its own (35.5% and 28.6% on the 107 known tiers, chance 21.1%). The author reviewed the proposals (doc 'Tier binding review') and accepted every suggested role.
decision: Accept suggested, all 186 (author, 18 Nov 2026, 22:00 Kyiv time).
is_an_extension: This is an extension, kept apart on purpose. The original ledger files are not changed and must not be merged with it: docs/data/tier_map.json and docs/data/ledger.json stay exactly as they were.
made_where: RSOS-Multimodal-Cue-Framework, by Claude in the author's Cue Framework session. RSOS-Language is developed on a separate account and does not contain this file.
how_to_use: Read it as an overlay with architecture/tier_extension.py; a tier's role here applies only where tier_map.json has no response. Status stays 'specified' until a test shows its agent runs it ('built').
